meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容做成分页演示文稿,支持分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,能直接翻页讲解。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要把想法变成一份可现场翻页讲解、带备注的演示文稿。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to turn ideas into a deck you can present page by page with notes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你的内容写出一份 HyperFrames 幻灯片：分片揭示、分支、热点跳转、演讲者模式与备注；也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。产出是可导航的幻灯片，不是渲染好的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你明确说要幻灯片、演示文稿、pitch deck，或要把现有页面转成幻灯片时接管；如果只是顺带提到，它会先问你是否做成幻灯片再动手。

say.text: 把这份提纲做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片
给每一张幻灯片加上演讲者备注
say.note: 备注只在演讲者模式里显示

say.text: 把这个网页转成一份幻灯片
say.note: 会尽量保留原页面的设计与动效

howto.what_en: Claude authors HyperFrames slideshows — presentations, pitch decks, or decks with slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspots and presenter notes. It also converts an existing page into a deck; the output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask for a slideshow, presentation, pitch deck, or to convert a page into a deck. If the request is only adjacent, Claude confirms before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a HyperFrames slideshow
Add speaker notes to every slide in this deck
say_en.note: Notes show only in presenter mode

say_en.text: Convert this web page into a slideshow
say_en.note: Original design and motion are kept where possible
